answer_1.quote: We explore a set of automatic methods for making headlines more creative and appealing, with the exploitation of well‑known expressions and word embeddings.
answer_1.outputs: recommended known expressions and adapted expressions (alternative headlines/sub‑titles)

answer_4.quote: We asked 24 Portuguese‑speaking volunteers to answer the surveys. Each survey was answered by four different judges, who scored the proverbs recommended for ten headlines, according to their relatedness and funniness.
answer_4.guideline: Judges were asked to rate (a) the relation between the proverb and the news title and (b) how funny the proverb is; later evaluations also included novelty.
